$comment: The rule concept register. A concept is what makes a value stated at one tier comparable to a value stated at another. Concept assignment is a human judgement about two paragraphs and is recorded here, never inferred from rule-id similarity, unit compatibility, or subject proximity. Same discipline as a cited edge: no assignment without a person who read both.

concepts.label: Maximum parental leave authorized for a qualifying event
concepts.definition: The total parental leave a member may use arising from a single qualifying birth, adoption, or placement, before any commander-approved extension.
concepts.basis: Read against DoDI 1327.06 para 3.11.c and MARADMIN 051/23 paras 7.a.(1) and 11.d. MARADMIN 051/23 para 7.a.(1) states the entitlement as '12 weeks (84 days)', which is the sentence that makes the two tiers the same concept rather than two similar ones.
excludes: Convalescent leave. A different entitlement with a different basis, per MARADMIN 051/23 para 7.a.(1)(a).
Any extension granted under MARADMIN 051/23 para 8.a.(3). That is a commander determination, not a stated maximum.

concepts.label: Minimum length of a parental leave increment
concepts.definition: The smallest block a member may request when taking parental leave in more than one increment.
concepts.basis: DoWI 1327.06 para 3.11.c.(7)(a) 'blocks of at least 7 days each'; MARADMIN 051/23 para 8.a.(1)(b).

concepts.label: Maximum number of parental leave increments
concepts.definition: The greatest number of separate increments a member may take for one entitlement.
concepts.basis: DoWI 1327.06 para 3.11.c.(7)(a) 'for a maximum of 12 increments'; MARADMIN 051/23 para 8.a.(1)(b).

concepts.label: Window within which multiple qualifying events count as one
concepts.definition: The period within which two or more qualifying events are treated as a single event for allocation.
concepts.basis: DoWI 1327.06 paras 3.11.c.(6)(a) and (b) 'the same 72-hour period'; MARADMIN 051/23 para 8.b.(1).

concepts.label: Period after the qualifying event before unused leave is forfeited
concepts.definition: The time from the qualifying event within which parental leave must be taken or it is forfeited.
concepts.basis: DoWI 1327.06 para 3.11.c.(10)(c) 'before the expiration of 1 year from the date'; MARADMIN 051/23 para 8.c.(3).
concepts.note: The two tiers state this in DIFFERENT units - the issuance says '1 year', the corpus records 365 days. config/units.json refuses years, so this concept is expected to report NOT_COMPARABLE. That refusal is the point, not a gap: see verification/findings-forfeiture-window.md.
